heading: Why dual reporting
paragraphs: Organizational boundaries define customer value, product direction, and where innovation gets built, intentionally or by default. Splitting Build and Bridge across two people recreates the handoff this proposal removes: architecture decided in one org, implemented in another, with a review gate in between.

devLifecycle.eyebrow: DV's question at closing of discussions
devLifecycle.heading: Will the development lifecycle change?
paragraphs: Yes, on a timeline that depends on the goal of a company. BMAD-style structured workflows can meaningfully move a team from where AI-assisted development was a year ago to where it is today over the next two to three years.

However, staying ahead of the curve is a different bet, closer to what Kiro and similar agentic-first development models are designed for. The right choice depends on which race OneTrust intends to run.

close.heading: The role, in one sentence
close.statement: One role, spanning both organizations: building inside Sriram's team, bridging DV's transformation, and finding its natural place in the business as the business evolves.
